mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comment (board_id, member_id, content) VALUES (#{boardId}, #{memberId}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT c.comment_id, c.board_id, c.member_id, c.content, c.create_at, DATE_FORMAT(c.create_at, '%Y-%M-%d %H:%i') AS create_at_str, m.nickname as writer_nickname FROM comment c LEFT JOIN member m ON c.member_id = m.member_id WHERE c.comment_id = #{commentId}

SELECT c.comment_id, c.board_id, c.member_id, c.content, c.create_at, DATE_FORMAT(c.create_at, '%Y-%M-%d %H:%i') AS create_at_str, m.nickname as writer_nickname FROM comment c LEFT JOIN member m ON c.member_id = m.member_id WHERE c.board_id = #{boardId} ORDER BY c.comment_id ASC
